title: Associate Director, Student Organizations and Resources
bio: I serve as an advisor and resource for students, faculty, and external constituents, support student organizational development, and create and manage a collection of resources and event spaces at Harvard College. I provide support for the development, oversight, and assessment of the college’s student organization community, student organization resources, and event spaces. With help from the Coordinator of Student Organizations and Resources, our Graduate Assistant and Office Interns, I help coordinate the college’s event spaces, student organization management, and development, which supports the intellectual, social, and personal development of students outside the classroom. This includes the management of a diverse portfolio of over 450 Independent Student Organizations and the operations of Hilles. I can assist with: Hilles rentals Student Organization Center Online (SOCO) Event Registration
